html:
The 10 Days 9 Nights HANOI – HA LONG – NINH BINH – DA NANG – PHU QUOC package is a full North Central South journey that blends world-class scenery, culture and beach relaxation in one itinerary.

Start in the thousand-year-old capital Hanoi with a charming city tour and traditional water puppet show, then cruise through the UNESCO-listed Ha Long Bay, kayaking among thousands of limestone islands. Continue to Ninh Binh, often called “Ha Long Bay on land”, where you explore Hoa Lu Ancient Capital, the Trang An boat caves and the panoramic viewpoint at Mua Cave.

From the North, fly to vibrant Da Nang to visit Ba Na Hills & the Golden Bridge, Marble Mountains, the Coconut Palm Forest and the lantern-lit streets of Hoi An Ancient Town. The last days are for pure relaxation on the tropical paradise of Phu Quoc Island, with a cable car ride to Hon Thom, island-hopping by speedboat, and a fun-filled day at VinWonders and Vinpearl Safari.

Throughout the trip you stay in carefully selected 3–5* hotels, enjoy guided sightseeing, entrance fees as per program and convenient transfers. As a special bonus, you’ll receive a complimentary Vietnamese hair washing treatment or body massage in Hanoi, making this tour not only a discovery of Vietnam but also a truly pampering holiday.

DAY 1: WELCOME TO HANOI – HALF DAY CITY TOUR – PRIVATE TOUR

Upon arrival at Noi Bai Airport, you will be welcomed by our representative and transferred to your hotel for check-in and rest.

In the afternoon, the tour guide will pick you up for a 4-hour Hanoi city tour. You will visit Ho Chi Minh’s Mausoleum, Tran Quoc Pagoda, Train Street, and enjoy a Water Puppet Show.

  • Ho Chi Minh’s Mausoleum (outside)
    The mausoleum is clad in grey granite, surrounded by rows of square granite columns. In the centre stands the inscription “CHỦ TỊCH HỒ CHÍ MINH”. The grounds are planted with trees and flowers brought from all regions of Vietnam. This is one of the most important cultural and historical symbols of the capital.

  • Tran Quoc Pagoda
    Located on a small island on the south-eastern shore of West Lake, Tran Quoc Pagoda is nearly 1,500 years old and considered the oldest pagoda in Thang Long – Hanoi. During the Ly and Tran dynasties, it was the Buddhist centre of the citadel. Its architecture harmoniously combines solemnity and antiquity with the elegant landscape of the lake.

  • Train Street
    This narrow 200-metre street is lined with residential houses right next to the railway. When the train passes, you can feel the excitement and thrill as it rumbles by just about one metre from where you sit. That unique experience makes Train Street a must-see spot in Hanoi.

  • Water Puppet Show
    An indispensable traditional art form in Vietnam. The stage is a pool of water; the puppets are the main “actors”, controlled by skilful artists behind the curtain. Each show lasts 45–60 minutes, combining puppetry, live music, sound effects, and colourful lighting to create lively, captivating performances.

After the tour, you will receive a complimentary Vietnamese hair-washing experience or body massage package.

Overnight in Hanoi.

DAY 2: HA LONG BAY DAY CRUISE

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch – SIC Transfers & SIC Cruise

08:00 – 08:45 – Hotel Pick-up

English-speaking guide picks you up from hotels in the Hanoi Old Quarter. Pick-up time is approximate due to traffic; please be ready in the lobby.

11:45 – 12:00 – Boarding the Cruise

Arrive at Tuan Chau Marina by 22-seater limousine. Check in at our pier where the crew warmly welcomes you on board.

12:00 – 13:30 – Lunch on Board

The cruise departs Tuan Chau Harbor to discover the beauty of Ha Long Bay – a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Along the way, admire thousands of limestone islands such as Dog Rock, Duck Rock, and especially Thumb Rock, a limestone islet rising from the sea like a giant thumb.

Enjoy a buffet lunch with a wide variety of Vietnamese dishes and seafood.

13:30 – 14:30 – Explore Surprise (Sung Sot) Cave

Stop at Bo Hon Island. The guide leads you to Sung Sot (Surprise) Cave, the largest and most beautiful cave in Ha Long Bay.

After about 200 steps under the forest canopy, the cave entrance appears and a spectacular “underground paradise” opens in front of you. Explore the cave for about 45 minutes.

(Guests who prefer not to walk can remain on the cruise, relaxing on the sundeck or soaking in the jacuzzi.)

14:30 – 15:30 – Kayaking

The cruise heads to Luon Cave area. Here you can:

  • Enjoy kayaking for about 30 minutes, or

  • Sit on a rowboat paddled by local people to admire the peaceful scenery of Luon Cave.

15:30 – 16:30 – Titop Island

Stop at Titop Island. Climb partway up the mountain for a panoramic view of Ha Long Bay – a stunning 360° vista of limestone peaks and emerald waters.

17:00 – Sunset Party

Enjoy complimentary wine, Vietnamese tea, fresh fruit and small cakes while cruising back. Watch the sunset painting the sky with beautiful red, purple and yellow hues.

18:00 – Disembark – Limousine Back to Hanoi

Return to the harbor, board the limousine and travel back to Hanoi via the expressway (with a short break on the way).

20:30 – 21:00 – Drop-off at your hotel.

Overnight in Hanoi.

DAY 3: HANOI – NINH BINH (HOA LU – TRANG AN – MUA CAVE)

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch – SIC TOUR

07:00 – Pick-up from Hanoi Old Quarter / Opera House.

10:00 – Hoa Lu Ancient Citadel

Visit Hoa Lu, the ancient capital of Vietnam in the 10th–11th centuries. The remaining ruins lie amidst dramatic karst scenery, creating a mystical atmosphere. Nearby are the temples of the Dinh and Le emperors, restored in the 17th century on the original palace foundations.

13:30 – Trang An Scenic Landscape Complex

After a local lunch, depart for Trang An, a famous eco-tourism area:

  • 250-million-year-old limestone mountains

  • Flooded forests, rivers and caves

  • Archaeological and cultural relics

Take a sampan boat trip through tranquil waterways, limestone karsts and caves, fully immersed in peaceful nature.

15:30 – Mua Cave (Hang Múa)

Climb nearly 500 steps to the summit. At the top, a beautiful tower in traditional Vietnamese style awaits you alongside a breathtaking panorama of mountains and rice fields – one of the most iconic viewpoints in Ninh Binh.

After the tour, return to your Hanoi hotel.

Overnight in Hanoi.

DAY 4: HANOI – DA NANG – DRAGON BRIDGE & SON TRA NIGHT MARKET

Meals: Breakfast – PRIVATE CAR

  • Breakfast at hotel, then transfer to Noi Bai Airport for your flight to Da Nang.

  • Upon arrival at Da Nang Airport, meet our representative and transfer to your hotel for check-in and rest (check-in time: 14:00–15:00).

In the evening, the driver will take you (no guide) to visit:

  • Dragon Bridge – famous for its dragon-shaped design and colourful lights at night.

  • Son Tra Night Market – a lively local market with food stalls, souvenirs, and entertainment.

Overnight in Da Nang.

DAY 5: MARBLE MOUNTAIN – COCONUT FOREST – HOI AN NIGHT MARKET

Meals: Breakfast, Local Dinner – SIC TOUR

Morning: Breakfast and free time.

13:50 – 14:00 – Pick-up for Marble Mountains

Visit Ngu Hanh Son (Marble Mountains) – a group of five limestone hills named after the five elements: Metal, Water, Wood, Fire and Earth. Over the centuries, the peaks have been revered as a spiritual site by the Cham people, Vietnamese emperors and generals. Explore caves, pagodas and viewpoints overlooking Da Nang.

Bay Mau Coconut Forest

Continue to the Coconut Forest, lying along the banks of the Hoai, Thu Bon and De Vong rivers. Take a basket boat ride into the mangrove forest:

  • Enjoy fresh air along quiet waterway channels lined with nipa palms.

  • Watch locals casting fishing nets – like a live folk performance.

  • See exciting basket-boat spinning shows and fun “boat racing” on the water.

Hoi An Ancient Town & Night Market
Head to Hoi An Ancient Town, a charming trading port preserved from the 15th–19th century:

  • Wander lantern-lit streets, old houses and narrow alleys.

  • Take photos and shop for local handicrafts.

  • Experience lantern releasing or small candle-lit boats on the river.

  • Enjoy a local dinner with delicious Hoi An specialities.

Overnight in Da Nang.

DAY 6: BA NA HILLS & GOLDEN BRIDGE

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch – SIC TOUR

08:30 – Depart to Ba Na Hills along the Nguyen Tat Thanh coastal road. See Thuan Phuoc Suspension Bridge, Thanh Beach and Red Beach (where the French first landed in Da Nang).

09:00 – Arrive at Ba Na – Suoi Mo Cable Car Station. Take the cable car to DeBay Station, passing Mo Stream waterfalls, primeval forest and red-leaf trees.

09:30 – Visit:

  • Golden Bridge – the world-famous pedestrian bridge supported by giant stone hands.

  • Le Jardin d’Amour area with:

    • Tinh Tam Garden

    • Old French horse-stable area

    • Nearly 100-year-old pomelo tree

    • Ruins of French villas

  • Linh Ung Ba Na Pagoda with a 27-metre Shakyamuni Buddha statue, Loc Uyen Garden and Quan Am Pavilion.

Continue to Gare DeBay to take the second cable car to the summit of Ba Na.

11:30 – Lunch at restaurant.

12:30 – 14:00

  • Conquer Nui Chua Peak (1,487 m) – the “roof” of Da Nang.

  • Enjoy panoramic views of Da Nang City and Da Nang Bay, often floating in a sea of white clouds.

  • Walk along forest trails to see ruins of ancient villas, the outdoor opera house and Debay Suspension Bridge.

Then visit Fantasy Park, one of the world’s largest indoor amusement parks, with games such as: Love Wheel, Skiver Pilot, Fire Racing Track, Bumper Cars, Haunted House, Mortar games, Spider-Man, Free-Fall Tower, etc.

16:30 – Take the cable car down.

Overnight in Da Nang.

DAY 7: DA NANG – PHU QUOC

Meals: Breakfast – PRIVATE CAR

  • Breakfast at hotel.

  • Driver transfers you to Da Nang Airport for your flight to Phu Quoc Island.

  • Upon arrival, our representative will pick you up and transfer you to your pre-booked hotel for check-in and relaxation (check-in time: 14:00–15:00).

Overnight in Phu Quoc.

DAY 8: PHU QUOC – THOM ISLAND & 4 ISLANDS BY SPEED BOAT

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Local Buffet) – SIC TOUR

Cable Car + Aquatopia Water Park & Three Islands by Speed Boat

09:00 – Guide picks you up and transfers to the harbour.

Board the speed boat to explore islands in southern Phu Quoc:

  • Gam Ghi Island – Snorkel among coral reefs and relax on the beach.

  • Xuong (Mong Tay) Island – More colourful corals and clear waters for snorkelling.

  • May Rut Island – White-sand lagoon, chill-out spots and photo corners.

Optional: Sea Walker (extra cost)
Walk on the seabed with a special helmet, surrounded by fish and vibrant corals.

Arrive at Thom Island:

  • Enjoy Aquatopia Water Park with more than 20 modern water games from world-class manufacturers.

Return via Hon Thom Cable Car (around 25 minutes):

  • Admire panoramic views of islands and the Sun Kiss Bridge at sunset (weather permitting).

~17:00 – Back to hotel.

Overnight in Phu Quoc.

DAY 9: FULL DAY VINWONDERS & VINPEARL SAFARI

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch – PRIVATE TOUR

After breakfast, transfer to discover:

Vinpearl Safari Phu Quoc

  • Vietnam’s largest wildlife conservation park and the only open semi-wild safari in the country (about 380 hectares).

  • Take a bus tour inside the safari to see animals roaming freely in natural-style habitats: giraffes, zebras, rhinos, lions, tigers and many rare species such as Arabian oryx, cranes, white-necked swans, etc.

  • Enjoy various animal shows (time-dependent).

Note: Safari closes at 16:00 daily. Bus inside the safari park is not included in the ticket price and is paid on spot.

VinWonders Phu Quoc (Afternoon)

Explore Vietnam’s largest theme park (approx. 50 hectares) with 6 themed zones and 12 sub-themes:

  • Thrilling rides & roller coasters

  • Water park slides

  • Indoor games

  • Street performances & musical fountain shows

  • 5D cinema and many other attractions

Overnight in Phu Quoc.

DAY 10: PHU QUOC – DEPARTURE

Meals: Breakfast – PRIVATE CAR

  • Breakfast at hotel.

  • Free at leisure until check-out.

  • Driver transfers you to Phu Quoc Airport for your flight home.

End of services.
